title: Agents
description: What agents are told: the instructions the packs ship under those the map keeps, said where each is for (a session's start, the working rules, a tool, a file); the brief a launched session starts from; and the schema an agent is given unless it asks for more.

styles.title: Registered as a run
styles.body: This session is registered in Archipelago, the owner's map of work and dependencies, as run {run}, called "{title}" after this chat, on the workspace "{workspace}" ({workspace_id}).

styles.title: Name an item by its link
styles.body: Name an item to a person as [its name]({link}), never a bare id; ids stay in tool calls.

styles.title: The repository it is in
styles.body: Repository: {title} ({id}).

styles.title: Where things stand
styles.body: Where things stand: view "handoff" with repo {repo}. {since}: {counts}.

styles.title: Since the last session ended
styles.body: Since the last session here to end, {title}, began ({began} UTC)

styles.title: Since a week ago
styles.body: In the last week

styles.title: What was left and bites
styles.body: And {marks}.

styles.title: Open work nothing blocks
styles.body: Open work and issues here that nothing blocks:

styles.title: Not confirmed for long
styles.body: not confirmed for {days} days: check it before relying on it

styles.title: Blocked work
styles.body: Blocked work here:

styles.title: Hubs with no view
styles.body: Hubs here with no view of their own (each holds enough to be the hub of its problem; when you work in one, give it its views: lens items about it, named for the questions they answer. View "hubs" says how much each holds):

styles.title: A folder the map does not know
styles.body: Archipelago does not know a {place} for this folder{remote}. If its work belongs in the map, give a {place} there this address as its {address}.

styles.title: Whose checkout it is
styles.body: (a checkout of {remote})

styles.title: Put what agents settled to the owner
styles.body: For the owner, in your first reply: since they last looked, agents have settled {count} {questions} on their own judgment{owners}. Show them these, a line for each, and ask them to confirm or correct. When they have answered, call settle with action confirmed, upto {upto} and what they said; change or reopen what they correct.

styles.title: Answers kept as the owner's
styles.body: (and recorded {count} more as the owner's own answers in chat: say how many, and list them only if asked, with query "attention", reason to_confirm)

styles.title: More to confirm
styles.body: and {count} more: query "attention" with person "me" and reasons ["to_confirm"].

styles.title: An exclusive resource
styles.body: Exclusive resource "{title}" ({id}) is {state}. Claim it with the pelago assign tool, action claim (holder {run}), before using it, and give it back with revise, action release, after.

styles.title: A resource held
styles.body: HELD by {holder}: do not use it

styles.title: A resource free
styles.body: free

styles.title: A token limited elsewhere
styles.body: This machine’s Archipelago token is limited to some repositories, and this folder is not a checkout of one that is theirs: the session is not registered in Archipelago, and its work is not kept there. Tell the owner in your first reply; a token for this repository is made in Settings.

styles.title: The server restarted
styles.body: The Archipelago server has restarted since this session began (at {started}{commit}).

styles.title: The commit it runs now
styles.body: , now running commit {commit}

styles.title: Actions new since
styles.body: Actions new since you were given the tools: {actions}.

styles.title: No action new
styles.body: No action is new since you were given the tools.

styles.title: What the owner did since
styles.body: Since you last heard from Archipelago, the owner did this in the map (web UI or CLI). Take it into account, and act on it if it is addressed to you:
